# cubepath_object_storage_event_rule (Resource)

Sends the events of an Object Storage bucket (objects created, removed or tagged) whose key matches prefix and suffix to a cubepath_object_storage_event_destination. Rules are applied in the background; Terraform waits until the rule is active. Import with the rule UUID, or <bucket_uuid>/<rule_uuid> to skip the search through every bucket (terraform import cubepath_object_storage_event_rule.example <bucket_uuid>/<rule_uuid>).



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cubepath_object_storage_event_rule" "new_photos" {
  bucket_uuid      = cubepath_object_storage_bucket.photos.id
  name             = "new-photos"
  destination_uuid = cubepath_object_storage_event_destination.uploads.id
  events           = ["object.created"]
  prefix           = "incoming/"
  suffix           = ".jpg"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_uuid` (String) UUID of the bucket. Changing it forces a new rule.
- `destination_uuid` (String) UUID of the event destination. It must be enabled.
- `events` (Set of String) Event types: object.created, object.removed and/or object.tagging (1 to 3).
- `name` (String) Rule name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule sends events. Defaults to true.
- `prefix` (String) Only keys starting with this prefix (up to 1024 characters). Defaults to all keys.
- `suffix` (String) Only keys ending with this suffix (up to 1024 characters). Defaults to all keys.

### Read-Only

- `error_message` (String) Why the rule could not be applied, when status is error.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the rule.
- `status` (String) pending, active or error.

## Import

```shell
terraform import cubepath_object_storage_event_rule.example <bucket_uuid>/<rule_uuid>
```
